profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a publicly traded semiconductor and software company, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, that reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 25, 2026, and trades on the NASDAQ under the ticker NVDA. The company's site focuses substantially on its AI model and infrastructure offerings, describing a broad ecosystem of tools for building and deploying enterprise AI agents.

NVIDIA's Nemotron is described on the company's site as a family of multimodal, open AI models built for agentic reasoning, covering tasks including advanced math, graduate-level science, and visual understanding. The site describes Nemotron models as available under the NVIDIA Open Model License, which permits use, modification, distribution, and commercial deployment without requiring credit to NVIDIA, and notes that NVIDIA publishes training datasets, techniques, and model weights. Specific models and tools mentioned include Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for specialized task completion, NeMo Switchyard for routing tasks across models, Nemotron Speech models for automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, and neural machine translation, and Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and embedding. Bryan Catanzaro, VP of applied deep learning research at NVIDIA, is cited on the site in connection with the Nemotron vision. ServiceNow is named as a partner that evaluated Nemotron's visual question-and-answer accuracy.

NVIDIA also offers NIM, described as inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options, available at build.nvidia.com and requiring an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license for production use. Additional tools referenced on the site include NVIDIA NeMo, NVIDIA Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Blueprints, and support for open-source libraries SGLang and vLLM. Supported hardware platforms mentioned include NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
